resume-analyzer.description:
AI-powered resume screening tool — upload up to 3 PDF resumes, specify a job position and requirements, and get per-candidate suitability scores, skill gap analysis, recruiter advice, and suggested interview questions. Includes a side-by-side candidate comparison report ranked by suitability score with strengths, weaknesses, and a final hiring recommendation. Built with Next.js and .NET Core.
* All names and data shown in screenshots are fictional and for demonstration purposes only

sales-analyzer.description: Full-featured Point of Sale (POS) system with AI-powered analytics — process sales through multiple payment channels (cash, QR, card) and manage transactions from a dedicated POS dashboard with real-time order tracking and receipt generation. On the analytics side, query products in natural language and let the AI extract filters (keyword, category, price range, rating) to search the database instantly; get AI-driven product ranking scored by ratings, review volume, and sentiment; per-product review summaries with average rating breakdowns; similar product recommendations; and a full-catalog insights dashboard surfacing top-performing brands, underperforming products, category gaps, and pricing recommendations. AI responses stream in real-time via SSE. Built with a Go (chi) backend, PostgreSQL database, Next.js frontend, and LLM calls routed through OpenRouter.

personal-financial-agent.description: Personal financial advisory agent — tracks income, expenses, and gives AI-powered financial insights. Go backend API with a Next.js frontend.
